TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In view of construction work of the Underground Yuge Yugeen Bharat Metro Station, Pandit Pant Marg between GRG Circle and PM Circle will remain closed for general public movement w.e.f. 23.02.2026 for a period of approx. 12 months.

📍 ROAD CLOSURE
-Pandit Pant Marg between GRG Circle and PM Circle shall remain closed for general traffic movement.

📍 SUGGESTED ROUTES
-Sansad Marg, Patel Chowk Roundabout, Ashoka Road, Baba Kharak Singh Marg, Bishambar Das Road, Gurudwara Rakab Ganj Road and Mahadev Road.

📍Commuters are advised to avoid the affected stretch, plan their journey in advance and use public transport wherever possible

📍Passengers travelling to ISBT/Railway Stations/Airports should keep sufficient travel time

📍Stay updated via Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
